tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Find Family Guy episodes by words in the title, by season, or by the year they first aired. Returns episode code, title, air date, writers, directors and the page URL. Use get_episode for one episode in full.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Return everything this site records for one episode: the story summary, air date, writers, directors, US viewing figure and identifiers. Accepts an episode code such as S03E12, a season and episode number, or an exact title.

tools.name: which_episode
tools.description: Find which episode something happens in. Searches the story summaries this site has written for every episode, not the titles. Give a few words describing the moment, such as a character, a place or an event.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description: Return what this site records for a Family Guy character: the profile written from cited sources, the household, the role, and the English voice actors.

tools.name: get_season
tools.description: Return one season of Family Guy: how many episodes it has, when it started and finished, and the episode list.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Return the credits this site records for one person: which roles they held and how many episodes they are credited on.

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description: Return one entry from the facts section: what a term means in Family Guy, with the page it is on. Omit the term to list every entry.

tools.name: site_stats
tools.description: Return the size and freshness of the database: how many episodes, seasons, characters and people it covers, and when the data was last refreshed.
